editionLabel: BGA Tournament rules of play · 31 March 2009 (English)
firstPlayerRule: In an even game, Black moves first from an empty board. In a handicap game, White moves first after all handicap stones have been placed.
clarifications: Colors must already have been assigned; the cited setup and play sections do not select who receives Black or White.
Section 4 places handicap stones on the star points in the traditional Japanese pattern unless otherwise stated. Handicap placement is completed before White's first turn.
